title: Example Article: The Template
subtitle: A placeholder article that shows and explains how an article page is structured
description: Placeholder article with no subject content: it shows the building blocks of a good article page — intro, text sections, definition, example, checkpoint, takeaways.

intro.title: This is a placeholder template
intro.text: This page teaches no subject matter — it shows you the blueprint of an article page. Every section is one building block and explains itself. Use this page as the template to copy for your own articles.

structure.title: How an article is structured
structure.text: An article leads from the intro to the key message: an info box at the top frames the page, followed by a few clearly named sections. Running text lives in text containers like this one — one section per thought, each with its own heading, so the table of contents (FAB at the bottom right) provides orientation. A definition block explains terms, an example box shows something concrete, and at the end a checkpoint and the takeaways consolidate what was learned. At the very bottom the article automatically links related content — here the seed glossary terms and timeline events from its meta file.

definition.title: Term: article page
definition.analogy: An article page is like a well-run museum: a sign at the entrance tells you what to expect. Then you walk through room by room — each room has one theme. At the exit, a panel sums up the essentials.
definition.precise: An article page is a standalone Angular component built on app-lesson-template. It declares its metadata (id, title key, reading time, difficulty), projects its sections as child elements, and is reachable via a route with a 4-character short id.
definition.example: This very page: component under src/app/pages/articles/seed-article-1/, meta in assets/data/core/articles/seed-article-1.json, route articles/seed-article-1 with short id sda1.

example.title: Example: the 4-character id
example.text: Every article gets a 4-character id (pageId). It yields a short URL that fits into printed material and QR codes.
example.label: Short URL
example.result: /article/sda1 redirects to /articles/seed-article-1 — try it in the address bar.

checkpoint.title: Check: got the template?
checkpoint.item1: I can name the building blocks of an article: intro, text sections, definition, example, checkpoint, takeaways, and related content.

takeaways.title: Key takeaways
takeaways.text:
1. **An article is a component**: its own page built on app-lesson-template, with metadata in articles/index.json plus its own JSON file.

2. **Building blocks over free text**: text container, definition, example box, and checkpoint give every article the same clear shape.

3. **Connected, not isolated**: through the related refs in its meta file, the article links glossary and timeline automatically — the knowledge net grows from data, not manual work.

This placeholder is deliberately content-free — replace the content, keep the structure.
